_README: Reviewed corrections for EGX filings the automatic path scales wrong, because the exchange's net-profit template inconsistently omits its 'Value In Thousand' unit word (or, for OIH, files the wrong basis first). Each was adjudicated against the raw filing and the company's own verified quarter-by-quarter progression (a model panel on 2026-08-26, every decision high-confidence and cross-checked against an independently filed sibling quarter), then pinned here so a person reviews them in a commit. apply_filing_corrections.py re-verifies each every build: the figure must still appear in a real secId=6 filing, the rescale must reproduce the value, and the stored value must still be the mis-scaled one it targets — so a correction that no longer applies is skipped, never forced.
